balls.text: short and straight into short and rotund Powar, who clears some room and pulls it down to long on. He doesn't exactly scamper back, but gets two.
on to his pads this time, Chawla looks to play a big flick but it hits his pads down to short fine leg.
lashes out this time, similar line from Balaji, but Chawla makes good contact and gets it down behind the point boundary. Nice shot.
short again, ouside off, beats Chawla's cut and is through to Parthiv Patel
slow bouncer, very short and well above Chawla's head, he gladly gets some bat on it and sends it to fine leg
Chennai's fielding is spot on again! Raina's the man at cover, Theron drives straight to him and takes off. Raina intercepts, takes good aim at the one stump he can see and fells it.
Bala lets this one slip down the leg for a wide

and the big fish has been hooked! Yuvraj has been starved of the strike by some smart bowling and fielding, and he tries to muscle this one over long on, mindful of the building pressure. It's well hit, but not well enough and balloons to George Bailey who takes it easily at long on

Bisla's gone by a mile! Hits the full toss, off the backfoot, straight to Hayden at mid on and takes off. Hayden picks up and throws accurately to Morkel who breaks the stumps. Bisla is well out of his crease.
full and wide outside off to deny Yuvraj the swing over midwicket. He stretches out and guides it down to deep point
gets it away finally, down to fine leg.
super fielding by Morkel off his own bowling, Bisla can't get it past Morkel. Yuvi is anxious for strike
missed run out opportunity from Raina at cover! full ball hit straight to him, and Yuvi, desperate for the strike runs well down, but Raina misses the direct hit
full on middle and leg, driven down the ground for a single.
yorker on middle, even Yuvraj can't do anything about it, digs it out to the offside
very full outside off, and Yuvraj is canny enough to get a thich outside edge that ran down quickly to third man
down the track and looks to loft over midwicket, but the ball is short of length and it goes high and falls short of the fielder in the deep
heaved away by Yuvraj to the leg side where Murali cleans up very well in the deep. Chepauk roars its appreciation!
very full of off, and dug out back to Ashwin
swept away nicely and gets it past short fine leg where Hayden gives up chase. Good shot
doosra on middle and turning marginally towards off, gets the leading edge
stays back and works it away to the leg side

very pretty shot from Kaif, but as he's done a few times in the past, he hits it straight down the fielder's throat! Full on leg stump, he comes down the track and picks it up well, but gets the placement all wrong, sends it straight to deep midwicket
short of a length on leg, Kaif works it away well off the back foot
top shot! Yuvraj picked his spot that time, it was on middle and leg and straightening, he came forward, opened up the offside and drove majestically over the covers. Great timing and placement
again, hit hard by Kaif to long off and Vijay intercepts it
full and drilled down the ground with a lot of power. Athletic fielding from Vijay at long on
down the track, and Raina looks to slip it down the legside for a stumping, but Kaif gets some bat and works it away
full on leg this time, Yuvraj gets forward and drives to long off
short of a length and turning in. Kaif stays back and gets it past Raina's dive towards the leg side
beautiful back of the hand slower ball at 116 kph, it lands short of a length, grips, kicks up and has Yuvraj in a mess, as he withdraws the bat at the last moment.
short and well wide outside off, but Kaif plays an impressive looking pull in front of square. Midwicket tidies up
fulltoss on off stump, Yuvi looks for the expansive pick up over the leg side, takes the outside edge and runs away to the covers
on to the pads, and he works it away towards midwicket this time to let Yuvraj have another go
very nicely played, gets forward and drives, probably the shot of the day, but not enough power to go for four straight down the ground.
slower ball, 115.9 kph and Yuvraj is caught by surprise, early into the flick, which ultimately turns into a fend down to fine leg.
tucked away towards midwicket. Yuvi will retain strike with that single
worked away off the front foot towards mid on
and again. Crouches back and pulls it down to long on
quick outside off, and beats Yuvraj. A bit of cat and mouse there.
full on Kaif's pads, he wrists it away and turns the strike over to Yuvi
slower ball, sliding down the leg and it's a wide.
length ball on on middle and leg, played away to midwicket

that's a Yuvraj special! Ashwin, unlike Murali is not getting much spin, and when it's tossed up, Yuvraj's going to free his arms and go for it, as he did this time. That ball was in the air for around 4 seconds before it landed in the stands at midwicket. Clean and crisp hit.
full on Kaif's middle stump, he gets forward and drives to long on
sliding down the leg, Yuvraj gets a some pad, very fine, and it is stopped by short fine leg
shorter, stays back and works it towards square leg
full and defended back.
super flat hit from Yuvraj! Short ball, he rocks back and pulls it with disdain over midwicket. That can be termed a DLF minimum!
hurries him with a good bouncer, but Yuvi manages to get it down to midwicket and run through for two.
full and angling in on middle, Yuvi tries to get it through midwicket, but it goes straight to the fielder.
sliding down the leg, and Yuvi cashes in with a very neat glance off the back foot. Very fine for four
full on off stump, Kaif gets forward and drives down the ground
short of a length on leg, stays back and works it down to deep square

gotcha! Murali is the king of Sri Lanka as far as today is concerned, he's vanquished Sanga and now he's sent back Mahela! Turning offie on middle, from around the wickets, straightens as Mahela gets forward, but it beats his attempt to work it across the line and thuds on the pads. Umpires should give these out more consistently for the good of the game.
outside off and straightening, Mahela looks to play a delicate late cut and it misses the outside edge. Not by much
similar shot, can't time it this time.
welcome boundary for Punjab and Yuvi., Sligtly short and turning towards the offside, Yuvraj stayed back and cut it nicely to behind square
this is nigh on unplayable from Murali. Huge spin from outside leg and across Yuvraj who was beaten all ends up.
and it shows. Nicely concealed slower ball and Yuvi was so early in the shot, he was playing it in the last IPL. Pops up, but lands safely towards mid off for one

and he's cleaned him up this time! Great, persistent bowling from Bala who has kept it simple, short of a length and on a nagging line. Irfan knew he needed to up the ante and looked to slog-pull the ball on leg stump, but could only get a meek inside edge on to leg stump.
short outside off, Irfan looks to cut it but can't get it past. A hint of extra pace from Bala and it beats Irfan
length ball on offstump, Mahela tips towards the covers and they run
full outside off, Irfan gets back and plays it with a horizontal bat down to deep cover
short of length, outside off, Mahela stays back and opens his face nicely to get it down to third man
big spin again, the legendary Murali kind, from outside leg, to well outside off. Irfan went for the sweep again, but don't think even he believed he was going to make contact
great stop from Raina at mid on. Punched hard by Irfan, but can't get it past the Chennai captain, who dives to his left and stops it.
big spin for the wizard. Turns sharply into Irfan from outside leg,  and beats the sweep
round the wicket, length ball, turning in from off, Mahela stays back and works it down to the off side

he's done him here! Murali beats Sanga, by pulling it back just a fraction. Sanga thought it was in his territory, licked his lips and jumped out, but Murali was the man chuckling as his Sri Lanka captain fell for the bait. Parthiv Patel did the rest behind the stumps.
Sanga wastes a wide, that's well short and wide outside leg and he pulls it straight to short fine leg
full to Irfan, he gets forward and yorks himself, pats it back to the bowler
chipped down the ground nicely by Sanga. Single to long on
goes for the sweep this time, gets it down to short fine leg
regal hit! Irfan's struck a purple patch, he shimmies down the track, its in his slot and he plays a wonderful loft-drive over midwicket. Ganguly would have been proud of that shot
fuller this time, Sanga gets forward and drives
length ball, Sanga makes room and slabs it back straight, just past Ashwin's hands and at great pace
short of a length again, outside leg and Pathan can't get it away to the leg side. Good start from Murali now.
nicely done, shortens the length seeing the batsman's charge, and he drives it to mid off
stays back and flicks it from outside leg, behind square
looks to sweep and misses from middle and leg
length ball, he runs down the track and flicks it to midwicket this time
full on leg, looks to flick but can't time it

Gony's having a poor day, he's dropped Sanga at third man. Nice little slower ball from Balaji, decieved Sanga and the ball ballooned to third man, where Gony was late in running in, he tumbled forward and spilt the chance
super shot from Sanga! Waltzs down the track, takes the ball on the bounce and shovels it over the covers.
short of a length, going from leg to off, Irfan gets down and slogs it down to midwicket.
good bouncer, well-directed and caught Irfan unawares, he let it go belatedly. Bala was fiddling with his sleeve there, might have been a signal to the rest of the team that a bouncer was coming up.
length ball, on leg and middle, Irfan defends off down to the leg side
finishes off with one short and slightly wide, but it's Sanga, not Irfan, on strike - he lets it go.
short of a length, on leg and middle, worked away by Irfan towards square leg
slightly fuller, Irfan looks to drive and gets an inside edge to midwicket, where Hayden swoops in and throws down the striker's end stumps. Irfan is back in time
beautifully played, and one must say, shoddy bowling. Short on leg, Irfan goes back on one leg and plays a good pull down to square leg.
better line, angles from leg to off short of a length, Irfan stays back and looks to nudge to point
short and wide, and Irfan is batting beautifully here! Stays back and gives it the good old up and over, above cover. One bounce four.
looks to sweep and break the shackles, but cannot make contact. Good start this from Ashwin, he's having a pretty good tourney
again, good line from Ashwin. Sanga gets forward and blocks
tight line, on leg and turning in, Sanga looks to nudge and run to the leg side, but cannot get it far enough
down the track and converts the length-ball almost into a yorker, gets it down to mid on
shortens the length marginally, Pathan defends down the track
full on Irfan's legs he gets forward and wrists it to square leg.
full and wide outside off, Sanga looks to cover drive and gets an inside edge on to his boot

nicely taken by Balaji at third man! Bopara was itching to get one away, sashayed down the track and looked to go with an expansive swing to the full ball outside off, and he timed it quite well. Bala runs in a few paces, bends forward and takes it well.
goes for a big pull and misses.
nice comeback, short of a length and pushes Irfan back, he handles it well and gets through for a single to cover.
beautifully controlled pull shot by Irfan, rolls his wrist well and sends it down to fine leg. Irfan's looking good.
full outside off, driven off the front foot straight to cover
hint of away swing for the first time, and good carry too for Gony. Bopara looks for an expansive cover drive and misses.
thickish outside edge this time, and it runs down to third man
pulled away, for a couple
similar ball, and he lets it go for a change
shortens the length, and wide outside off, but Pathan has enough time to drag it all the way to midwicket with a controlled pull. Nicely played, and no pace on this track.
similar line outside off, Irfan lets it go for a change.
full outside off at 135.2 kph, but Bopara can't time the cover drive off the front foot. Good start from Morkel.
same line, slightly shorter, Bopara stays back and guides it towards point.
outside off this time, short of a length, Bopara shoulders arms
huge appeal, length ball at 134.9 kph, on middle and leg, would have clipped the top of leg
short and wide outside off, Irfan gets a thick edge that goes in the air, but safe to deep point.
short of a length, sliding on to middle and leg, tucked away nto square leg. Bopara is off the mark.

Ashwin's gone! Fasten your seatbelts folks, we have a super over coming up! Pressure has taken its toll! Pathan keeps it slow and steady, on a length, Ashwin swings it away ram-rod straight to mid off, where Kaif takes the dolly. Punjab are ecstatic!

and he's got a dot ball!!! This could go down to the super over if he does it again! Straight length ball outside off and Ashwin can't connect. Sanga's standing neither here nor there, but collects the ball well! 1 off 1!
drama! Sanga's up, Irfan slips in the off cutter, Ashwin is totally deceived as he shuffles across, but somehow contrives a leading edge over cover and runs back for two. Scores are level!
length ball on leg stump, Morkel bunts it down to long on and turns the strike over. Over to you Ashwin!

oh Irfan, what have you done! It was in Morkel's slot, he missed the swing, it went to Sanga, Ashwin was off to steal a bye, Sanga took a shy at the striker's end and missed. Irfan gathered and took a shy at the non-striker's and missed as well! And they ran back for two!
Ho ho ho! Short and wide outside off, Morkel gives it the heave-ho, gets a thickish edge down to third man. Four lesser needed!

another dot!!! Theron keeps hitting that line and length, Ashwin has no room to work with and cannot get it through the off side. Morkel will have strike, and this is his chance to stand up and be counted.
great bowling, fast on middle and leg, giving Ashwin no chance of scoring

stumps everywhere! Theron has bowled with zest today and this was probably his best. Fast, length ball targetting middle, challenging Gony to try and find the fence. Gony obliged, and missed the ball, and CLATTER! Chennai are choking big time, it's all down to Morkel.
good slower ball, short of a length and Morkel stays back and dabs it to the off side. They run through for one, Gony on strike
keeps it tight outside off, no room for Gony to swing, he stays back and cuts it away for a single
Almighty swipe from Gony and he misses!
Oh, that's crucial! Slips one well down the leg, and Sanga does well to keep the damages down.
Morkel jumps out and looks to go heavy, over covers and it lands in deep cover, in no man's land
Tries to slog it over the leg side and gets it down to cover
Full on off and middle, raps Gony on the pads and Sanga appeals long and hard, it struck him marginally outside the line.
Short outside off, Gony misses the cut.

Chawla has his number this time! Draws him out of the track, with a leggie tossed up wide of the batsman, Patel misses the attempted drive and Sanga's got the bails off before you could say Parthiv. Huge wicket. Chennai are making rough weather of this chase.
Cool head on Patel's shoulders! Drops on one knee and sweeps it in the air, behind square. Despairing dive does not help.
full on off stump, Patel rises with the bounce and drives down the ground
slower ball, going from leg to off, quietly played away to cover
very short and over Morkel's head, before he can make contact with the pull
hit with as much power as you would escape from a pocket dynamo like Patel, muscles the full ball down to long off for one. It flew off the bat
full on leg, and driven hard into the square and over the head of the jumping Theron, down to long on
short of a length outside off and tapped away for a single
short, turning from leg to off, and Morkel can't get it away
fantastic stuff from Powar and Patel can't get it away. Runs down to third man
Pressure! Outside off this time, and Patel frees his arms to cut, but straight to point
and again. Powar is bowling slowly, on a tight leash and turning it into Patel from outside leg.
nice tight bowling, short of a length turning in from leg stump. Patel can't work it away
gets a thickish outside edge to the attempted cut and gets it down to third man. Fortune favours the brave little Parthiv
chips down again, gets to the pitch and drives it down to wide long off. Good over from Chawla.
another googly, full on legstump, Morkel does not pick it and gets the leading edge to cover
beautiful piece of bowling. Straight one that beat him all ends up, missed the outside edge and the off stump by a whisker
full this time and Patel jumps out, but can't time the on-drive well enough. Runs down to long on
leggie on leg stump, worked away by Morkel to short fine
quickish googly on leg and middle, Patel picks it and works it away off the backfoot through midwicket. Thinks of two and rightly rethinks.

gotcha! Chennai are crumbling and the crowd is in a lull now. Yuvraj's struck another blow, short and cramping Badri for room, he went for the cut and got a faint edge. Sanga put it down the first time, but regained in time before it touched the turf. Punjab have a sniff here.
length ball, going in with the arm from leg stump. Badri played it well and softly down to midwicket and hared down for two
short again and angling across Patel, who rocks back and flat bats it to wide mid off
but releases it now with a smart hit down to fine leg. Poor ball, short and wide down the leg, but it still needed to be hit. Patel obliged with a shovel pull
jumps out and looks to cut. Patel is feeling the pressure a bit.

and he's got two for the over! Theron's persisted with that line through the over and Vijay has not come forward even once. This time, it catches him on the crease, and it may have been sliding down the leg, but not in umpire Harper's book.
length ball on middle, Vijay stays back and defends
Slips down the legside this time and Harper extends his arms to signal wide
homing in full, on middle and leg, Vijay stays back and looks to work it away through the leg side

Theron's showed some really smart footwork here and Raina is run out!. Short of a length, and Patel looked to pull, got no timing and it bobbled down the pitch as they took off for a quick single. Theron ran down the pitch and kicked the ball with his right foot on to the stumps and Raina is caught inches short.
full outside off, driven to deep point
full on Patel's pads, worked away with his wrists, in the air towards long on
short and a fraction outside off, Patel cuts it away viciously and Piyush makes a tumbling save at point
runs it off the face towards point, nicely done again
oh, that's timing for you! Full toss on Raina's leg stump, but it still needed to be put away, he used the straight bat, nice back lift and a photo-finish follow through to get it over midwicket.
slips this one down the leg, Raina looks to sweep, misses and it's a wide
tight on middle and off, Patel stays back and dabs it nicely to short third man
full on leg, swept away
The life of Pi Patel is getting better and better! Gets under that short ball and executes the text-book hook shot, high over the fine leg boundary. He's packing a punch here!
full toss on off stump, Patel looks to wrist it away towards mid wicket, but can't elude mid on
very short at 125.5 kph, Raina will feel he's missed out. Pulls it straight down to fine leg.
tight line, on off stump, short of a length, dabbed away off the back foot for a good ole' tip and run behind point
short outside off, Patel stays back and tries to cross bat it straight down, but can't get past the bowler
short of length, outside off dabbed away off the back foot towards Raina.
sloppy bowling, it's one thing to bowl a slow loosener in this format, but even worse to slip it so wide down the leg side. Scratch that. On second thought, that can't go for four.
Raina comes forward this time and bends his back-knee and punches nicely down to long off
nicely played by Patel, gets down to the pitch and brings the wrists into play to get it to long on
slightly shorter, stays back and plays it down to mid off
full on off stump, driven down to long off
played away off the backfoot down to mid on
pitched up by Piyush, Patel gets forward and drives hard in to the ground and over Piyush's head for one
short, but no width for Patel to work with, cuts fiercely but it goes straight to deep cover
worked away from leg stump towards square leg to get off the mark

nifty bit of bowling from Powar! Foxes him with some classical offspin here. Hayden's down the track again, but announces his intentions a moment too soon, Powar sees him, pulls it back a little, defeats him in the flight and beats the attempted swipe to hit the stumps. Great work, big wicket.
pitched outside leg and rapped on the pads. Big appeal, but no way he's getting those.
Powar's not giving him the pace, so Hayden makes some for  himself! Jumps out, take sit on the full and despatches it disdainfully over midwicket
nicely flighted on middle, slow, less than 80 kph, driven down to long off

big Matty dictates terms! Full on his off stump, and it might have been turning in, but who is to say! Hayden got forward, to the pitch and hammered it high over long off. Super shot, literally tells the spinner, "Ima letya finish this time, but don't try pitching it in my half!"
up and over this time, tries to go over long on, and it gets to the fielder on the bounce
looks to flick it away, can't get it past short fine leg
nudged away from outside off, towards point for a brisk single. Good stop too from Theron
on leg stump, swept down to fine leg
short and turning into Patel, who rocks back and cuts can't put it away
slower ball, 113.1 kph on Patel's pads, he flicks it away nicely to deep square leg
short outside off, at 128.4 kph, Hayden pulls it hard down to long on. Fifty up for Chennai.
fuller, gets forward and driven back to the bowler
oooh, very close to taking out Hayden's off stump. Sanga's up, so Hayden tries to work the length ball away from the crease, misses everything, by very little
on the legs, stays back and works it down to fine leg
Shot of the innings so far! Just short of a length, but Patel was waiting for it, stayed back and shellacked it over midwicket. Expertly pulled, wonder if Haydo's training him!
length ball, angling across Haydos who hops on the backfoot and shoulders arms. A double sighting of this rarity.
fullish slower ball on middle stump, Patel picked it, waited and guided it past Kaif at point
on to his pads this time, Patel looks to stay back and work it away. Finds short fine leg
better line, outside off, Patel can't free his arms. Check-drives to point
gets it on the money this time, and it's slightly fast on leg stump. Hurries on to Patel who gets some pad on it.
cliche chance, am not gonna let it go. Rusty is rusty, and slips it well down the off side. Wide
short and not very fast. Enough time for little Pi Patel to rock back and pull it away with a flourish. Welcome to Indian, Rusty Theron!
short of a length, outside off and for a change, Matthew Hayden shoulders arms. Not been seeing much of that lately, from this man.
nice little save by Yuvraj at mid off. Patel gets forward to the half volley and drives well down the line. Yuvraj puts his left hand out and saves a sure four

action action everywhere! Short of a length, but Hayden was walking down and looking to mow it towards the leg side, it went straight to mid on, who let rip a good throw that hit the stumps and deflected for an over throw
ah, short, really short and called a wide for height this time
pulled away fiercely! Hayden in this form does not need no Mongoose. It was short and asking to be hit, he did just that. Drilled through midwicket
short and wide outside off, Patel stays back and tries to cut, but somehow gets it to cover, they get through for one
short of a length and just outside off, he looks to cut it away
looks to pull, but he's cramped for room and can't make contact
hit hard off the backfoot, that really stopped on him and slowed, and Yuvraj at mid off did not see it early enough, it ran away for four.

ok, that was funny! Hayden walks out to Powar and gets a hint of top edge, but lot of muscle into his loft over long on. Kaif thought he had a chance and kept back-pedalling until he trod on the ropes and tripped to fall on his backside, the ball fell well behind him.
and again, short of a length, but not short enough to pull this time, but Patel gives it a good hard swing, and misses
ooh, too close for the cut, but Patel gives it a go all the same. Does not get contact, and misses the outsid edge too, not by much
short and angling in to Hayden, who gets inside the line, stays back and works it away to midwicket for one
short of a length outside off, Patel opens the face and runs it along the ground behind square
short again, but straighter, Patel brings out the pull, but cannot make connection
expertly played by little Patel! short and slightly wide, got big on him, he hung his bat out and dabbed it nicely, in the air, to third man
short again, spinning from middle to off, Hayden cuts it away
but he can't make use of it, tries to swing him away to the leg side and does not connect
no-ball! Powar bowls a nice ball spinning and looping, but over steps. Hayden wants the mongoose for the free hit!
very wide down the leg this time, and turning in, Patel gets down on his kneww to sweep and gets it down fine
full and hits Patel's pads, big appeal but that's not out
short outside leg and turning towards Patel's offstump
not this time though! Hayden sizes this up, swings again over mid on and the timing is awesome. One bounce for four
and again! Hint of away swing from Irfan and it's enough to beat Hayden's big swing, through to Sanga
swing and a miss! Hayden steps out a bit and gives it a big swing straight, but it eludes his outside edge
short and wide outside off, carved away by Patel towards third man
similar line and length, Parthiv stays back and defends down the ground
shorter and wide outside off, check driven by Parthiv to the offside
slips down the leg first ball, that's a wide
